KolektorSDD2: images provided and annotated by Kolektor Group; dataset distributed by ViCoS Lab.
Authors: Jakob Bozic, Domen Tabernik, Danijel Skocaj.
Source: https://www.vicos.si/resources/kolektorsdd2/

This trial preserves original sample image and mask bytes.
Citation: Mixed supervision for surface-defect detection: from weakly to fully supervised learning, Computers in Industry, 2021.
https://prints.vicos.si/publications/385
